text:
mara: heads-up — nightly eval alerted a big spike after yesterday's prompt bump canary (prompt-bump PR #4312)

eval-bot: nightly-evals/2026-03-20: prompt-bump-canary: FAIL
summary: overall pass rate down 93.1% -> 88.7% (-4.4pp). pset-anchor failures up 1.2% -> 6.9%.

zach: who rolled the bump? i saw the PR merged around 02:40 UTC

mara: that was me, small wording simplification on intent qualifiers. thought it was low-risk. sorry, didn't run the expanded canary set overnight. :grimacing:

sophia: can you paste an example of the new prompt vs old?

mara: old: "When asked about X, clarify whether user intended Y or Z."
new: "When asked about X, ask a clarifying question to decide between Y or Z."

leo: that change pushes the model to output questions instead of short clarifications — explains rerank hit and downstream metric drop

zach: numbers: nightly diffs show rerank precision down 7.3% on anchor tasks, and hallucination token rate +2.4ppt. latency unaffected

sophia: do we know if this is model-specific (quantized vs fp16) or prompt-only?

mara: canary ran on dedicated-staging with model: redwood-gpt-medium-quant-v2; i spun the canary only on canary pool

leo: suspicious that quantized variant amplifies question style, see this sample from failing case: 
```
Input: "Book a meeting with my team about the Q3 roadmap."
Old prompt -> Output: "Do you want me to include the design and product teams?"
New prompt -> Output: "Who should I invite? What time works?"
```

zach: new prompt encourages more open-ended question generation, leads to mismatch with expected canonical short clarifier in pset -> reranker punishes it

sophia: recommendation: revert prompt bump on prod canary, run focused A/B on both quant and fp16, and add targeted examples to promptset to avoid open-ended expansions

mara: i can revert the merge and open a followup that narrows phrasing to preserve short clarifiers

eval-bot: created ticket TF-7892 referencing nightly diff artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nightlies/1764003210/diffs.tar.gz

leo: also want to run a quick ablation — old prompt + quant-v2 and new prompt + fp16 to isolate interaction. i'll queue sims now

zach: if ablation confirms interaction, we should consider rebaseline flow instead of blind revert — but agree revert while we investigate is safer for prod

sophia: also pinging docs/devex to update prompt change notes and add to canary checklist: include expanded eval set and quant check

mara: thanks, reverting PR in 10m. will post revert PR link when done

zach: great. after revert and ablation results, let's add 5 canonical examples that force short clarifier and lock prompt tokens for that intent

mara: revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/promptbank/pull/4320 (revert of #4312)

sophia: noted TF-7892 and will prepare canary checklist edit. thanks team. :thumbsup:
